Medical Services

Health & Community Development

The BUBT Health & Community Development is dedicated to ensuring the health, safety, and well-being of students, faculty, staff, and visitors. Our mission is to provide prompt medical support, essential health services, preventive care, and emergency response within the campus.

Room: 205, Floor: 1, Building: 3, BUBT Main Campur

About the Office

The Health & Community Development Office at BUBT promotes the health, well-being, and social development of the university community. It provides medical services, health awareness programs, and initiatives that foster community engagement, wellness, and social responsibility among students and staff.
5000+
Students Served
25 Mins
Processing Time
6
Staff Members
100%
Accuracy Rate

Services of Our Office

General Medical Services

- First Aid Services - Emergency Medical Aid - Basic Health Check-ups - Medicine Distribution - Health Counseling - Injury Management (cuts, burns, sprains, etc.) - Referral to Nearby Hospitals if Required

Doctor Consultation

- Consultancy Services with Certified MBBS Doctor - Regular Health Assessment - Advice for Chronic Conditions (e.g., Diabetes, Hypertension)

Health Awareness & Preventive Care

- Health Awareness Programs - Seasonal Disease Advisories - Basic Mental Health Guidance - Hygiene and Wellness Campaigns
